PANGAEA, https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.937486,

In: Kutterolf, S et al. (2021): Marine tephra thicknesses, density measurements, sedimentation rates and ages of Aegean Arc tephras [dataset bundled publication]. PANGAEA, https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.937928

We show here the data that are associated to the paper: The medial offshore record of explosive volcanism along the central to eastern Aegean Volcanic Arc, part 2: Tephra ages and volumes, eruption magnitudes and marine sedimentation rate variations, submitted for publication at G-Cubed. Table 3 summarizes the marine tephra thicknesses found in the POS513 cores and includes a compilation of the respective tephra occurrence in the entire Mediterranean region.
